description: This file defines data models and query parameters related to bond prices, including classes for querying bond data and representing bond price details, utilizing pydantic for data validation.

classes.name: BondPricesQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching bond prices, including filters like country, issuer, ISIN, currency, and maturity dates.

classes.name: BondPricesData
classes.description: Represents bond price details such as ISIN, issuer, coupon rate, price, yields, duration, and relevant dates.
